answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock: each agent starts on a low terrace with a 15 POA bond locked, and climbs only as its behavior fingerprint — timing, counterparties, rhythm — stays stable 20 epochs. A fake drifts like a dune in the wind, never matching a real fingerprint, so higher tiers stay shut. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 15 POA plus 20 epochs. One honest agent pays 15 POA once and reaches the oasis of paid work, never diluted by copies.
